scope: Read-only diagnosis; offline parser calls only; no paid calls; protocol, manifest, gateway and execution state unchanged.

prelude.reproduction: Paid failure retained in admission audit; narrow parser incompatibility reproduced offline.

candidates.hypothesis: Null/zero input or cache counters in message_delta rejected as invalid/decreasing.
candidates.support: Native Jwe explicitly accepts null/zero deltas as absent; gateway rejects them.
candidates.disconfirming_check: Raw stream could show positive monotone counters only; raw stream was not retained.

candidates.hypothesis: Unsupported optional usage field or null pricing metadata.
candidates.support: Native accumulator supports nullable optional fields; gateway rejects them.
candidates.disconfirming_check: Start usage in stdout has no unsupported fields. Final transcript extras are synthesized by Jwe and cannot establish actual stream fields.

candidates.hypothesis: Message event ordering differs from gateway mock.
candidates.support: Audit catches all parser ValueErrors without reason.
candidates.disconfirming_check: Native completed the first response and emitted a tool call, lowering likelihood of invalid ordering; legal gateway-excluded ordering remains possible.

prelude.picked: 1 as strongest compatibility explanation, not a proven unique trigger for the paid failure.

native_source_evidence.fact: Stores raw message in Zy and merges usage via Jwe.

input/cache counters replace previous only when nonnull and >0; output_tokens uses nullish fallback; optional pricing fields use nullish fallback; output_tokens_details and fallback_credit are synthesized in normalized result.
SDK accumulator skips null input/cache fields; permits output_tokens_details and fallback_credit.

offline_reproduction.method: Import current gateway and feed synthetic message_start(actual retained usage), message_delta, message_stop; no network.
offline_reproduction.null_input_delta: Denied: decreasing or invalid usage counter
offline_reproduction.zero_input_delta: Denied: decreasing or invalid usage counter

evidence_levels.unique_paid_trigger: Not established; raw SSE absent and audit omitted parser reason.

conservative_fix_proposal: Normalize only explicit known delta fields according to pinned native semantics, retaining previous nonzero input/cache counters for null/zero placeholders; never discard a positive nonzero decline.
Keep initial pricing/model validation, output bounds, byte/token bounds, reservations and block-on-unknown controls intact; nullable delta metadata can retain validated prior values.

If supported, validate output_tokens_details as a narrowly known nonnegative thinking_tokens subset of cumulative output, and permit only null fallback_credit; reject unknown billing fields and nonnull credits.
Add offline regressions for null/zero deltas, cache breakdown, thinking detail, genuine positive counter declines, unknown/nonstandard pricing and invalid event ordering.
Persist only bounded usage-schema and exception-reason diagnostics on future parser failure; never prompts or authorization headers.
remaining_gap: Cannot identify the exact original SSE key/event after the fact. Do not claim exact root cause, accept arbitrary usage, erase held charges, mutate preregistration or launch another paid diagnostic.
